purpose: human approve/reject review template for the 10-F-A repaired long/short book; every candidate defaults to NEEDS_REVIEW; no auto-approval; no Paper Trader writes; no orders; no automation
safety_badges: This package is for human review only - it is not a tradeable instruction.
No orders are created, staged, or sent anywhere by this harness.
Nothing is automated; every position is human approve/reject gated.
A human must individually approve or reject each candidate.
Paper-only; no live capital, no broker, no execution.
No broker connection exists or is configured by this phase.
No Paper Trader signals or trade decisions are written.
Quarterly rebalance is a manual, reviewed decision - never scheduled execution.

column_legend.side: LONG or SHORT - the book side this candidate sits on (read-only).
column_legend.sector: Repaired GICS sector used for sector-neutral scoring (read-only).
column_legend.sector_repaired: True if Phase 10-F-A repaired this name's sector from owned metadata (read-only).
column_legend.sector_is_unknown: True only if the sector is still Unknown after repair (read-only; expected False).
column_legend.comp_sn: Sector-neutral composite score = the review score (read-only).
column_legend.cohort: old/new cohort the name belongs to (read-only).
column_legend.before_review_label: Side label from the 10-E book before the 10-F-A rerank (read-only).
column_legend.review_decision: HUMAN-EDITABLE. Ships NEEDS_REVIEW for every row. Set to one of NEEDS_REVIEW / APPROVE / REJECT / HOLD_FOR_MORE_INFO.
column_legend.conviction: HUMAN-EDITABLE. Optional conviction note, e.g. HIGH/MED/LOW (blank on generation).
column_legend.approved: FALSE for every row at generation. The template never pre-approves anything.
column_legend.order_action: NO_ORDER for every row. This template never implies or creates an order.

next_step_for_human: open repaired_book_review_template.csv, set review_decision per row (APPROVE / REJECT / HOLD_FOR_MORE_INFO); nothing downstream changes until a human acts in a separately-gated step
constraints_honored: reads only the owned 10-F-A repaired book
